rows.role_title: 委員長 / 党首 — chair of the Japan Socialist Party and, from its 1996 renaming, the Social Democratic Party
rows.text: On 29 August the party's standing executive committee set up the leader election headquarters and decided to hold a leader election; it also set the sixth national representatives' meeting for 26 October.

rows.role_title: 委員長 / 党首 — chair of the Japan Socialist Party and, from its 1996 renaming, the Social Democratic Party
rows.text: The page explains that a new leader's term runs for two years from the next regular convention, and that the national representatives' meeting would be asked to approve the new leader also serving the rest of 福島みずほ前党首's term.
